answers.question: The race got moved two weeks earlier, to October 18, because of the bridge works. That's three weeks from today. I've only done one 20. Do I still have time for my 22-miler?
answers.answer: You can still get to a 22‑mile run before the race, but it will be tough with only two weeks left in the peak phase.  The plan keeps the long run at 15–17 miles to preserve legs, so if you want a 22‑mile session you’d need to add it in a week after this one, not this week.

In the next week, a 15‑mi long run will keep the mileage and intensity appropriate.  If the athlete wants to push to 22 mi, the next two weeks could include a 20–22 mi run, but that would be pushing the volume too high; best to keep legs fresh.
